name: Early Marriage
overview: Scripture honors the sacred union of marriage, emphasizing the deep bond between husband and wife as one flesh, as established in Genesis 2:24. The love and commitment exemplified by Jacob's willingness to serve for Rachel (Genesis 29:18) highlight the seriousness and devotion involved in entering marriage. Additionally, Deuteronomy 24:5 underscores the importance of nurturing the new marital relationship by allowing time for the husband to care for and strengthen his wife. Proverbs further affirms that finding a prudent wife is a blessing and favor from the Lord, underscoring the divine value placed on godly marriage partnerships.
